NEW Charming Home in the Heart of Nashville

Welcome to a delightful residence nestled in the vibrant and sought-after neighborhood of Nashville, TN. This charming home offers a perfect blend of classic elegance and modern comfort, making it an ideal haven for those seeking a distinctive urban lifestyle.
Minimum age of 25 required.

Please see pics for Nashville STR permit info.

The space
The home is awesome with a floor plan that works well for groups of 8-10. Some of the best features of the home include a selfie wall with props, roof top deck and 2 living spaces! The home also is equipped with large beds, only queen and king will do! 

***Please note there are 6 total beds, 4 kings and 2 queens. The master bedroom is equipped with custom queen over king bunk bed. There is also a queen bed in the 4th floor which is a murphy bed.

Guest access
Guest will receive access directions within 72 hours of check in.
